name: Neko Firefox
tagline: A self hosted virtual browser that runs in docker and uses WebRTC.
description: Welcome to Neko, a self-hosted virtual browser that runs in Docker and uses WebRTC technology. Neko is a powerful tool that allows you to run a fully-functional browser in a virtual environment, giving you the ability to access the internet securely and privately from anywhere. With Neko, you can browse the web, run applications, and perform other tasks just as you would on a regular browser, all within a secure and isolated environment. Whether you are a developer looking to test web applications, a privacy-conscious user seeking a secure browsing experience, or simply someone who wants to take advantage of the convenience and flexibility of a virtual browser, Neko is the perfect solution.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Neko password admin
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-neko-firefox application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-neko-firefox
  # The `big-bear-neko-firefox` service definition
  big-bear-neko-firefox:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: neko-firefox
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: m1k1o/neko:firefox@sha256:7b6841196ec82e33f1b3db9b5789493e2b149ba5db8170d2baacb5d62e26fcff
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Shared memory size
    shm_size: "2gb"
    # Port mapping HOST:CONTAINER
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
      - "52000:52000/udp"
      - "52001:52001/udp"
      - "52002:52002/udp"
      - "52003:52003/udp"
      - "52004:52004/udp"
      - "52005:52005/udp"
      - "52006:52006/udp"
      - "52007:52007/udp"
      - "52008:52008/udp"
      - "52009:52009/udp"
      - "52010:52010/udp"
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      NEKO_SCREEN: 1920x1080@30
      NEKO_PASSWORD: neko
      NEKO_PASSWORD_ADMIN: ${SECRET_NEKO_PASSWORD_ADMIN}
      NEKO_EPR: 52000-52010
      NEKO_ICELITE: "1"
      NEKO_DEBUG: "1"
      NEKO_NAT1TO1: "[CASAOS_IP]" # Replace with your own IP address
